design.name: 冰蚕
design.brief: The ice silkworm (冰蚕) of Yuanjiao Mountain from the Shi Yi Ji, which lives under frost and snow and spins silk that no fire can burn, grown into a giant artillery larva: a fat segmented silkworm about 3 m long, pale moon-white translucent segments with cold blue frost scales, two short black horns on its head, rows of small stubby legs, a huge round throat silk gland that glows cyan when it fills (weak spot), and a half-spun frozen cocoon of shining silk on its back. Rears up its front half to spit. Slow, bloated, eerie.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert roster (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast): chunky simplified masses, oversized head and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges, ice as a few big faceted crystal shapes (never thin needles or noisy frost texture), fur as a few large carved clumps.
design.turnaround_pose: lying along the ground in a neutral pose (NOT reared up): the long segmented body straight and level, every stubby leg planted on the ground, the head facing straight ahead with the mouth closed, the two short black horns, the throat silk gland half full and painted as opaque pale cyan (no halo), the half-spun frozen cocoon on its back
design.turnaround_digits: every stubby leg separate and visible; the whole body from head to tail end fully inside the frame; in the side views the long body must fit inside the view with margin.
